Class RepositoryFactory

java.lang.Object
repository.RepositoryFactory
public class RepositoryFactory extends Object
Simple Factory: the only place in the application that knows the concrete repository classes. Which ones are created depends on the persistence type from the configuration, and both repositories are always created for the same type.
